items.html: Now, when this new light, the name MA of Alephs, came out, it selected from the Nekudot of SAG, in which the breaking had occurred, whatever it could select from them, and they joined and united with it. Then MA became the male aspect, and SAG became the female aspect. But since this SAG became a female to MA, it now acquired another name — the name BON of Heys, spelled thus: Yod-Vav-Dalet, Hey-Hey, Vav-Vav, Hey-Hey. And it is no longer called by the name SAG, but by the name BON.
